འོང་བ: coming (the present stem 'ong 'come' + -ba): 'ong ba yin no 'is coming'
ཡིན་བའི: which is, of being (yin 'be' + -ba'i, the print's spelling of -pa'i 'of')
ལྟུང: to fall (ltung, the present and future stem of the verb whose past is lhung)
སྐྱེ: birth, to be born (skye); skye rga na 'chi 'birth, ageing, sickness and death'
ཉམས་སུ་མྱོང: to experience, to go through (nyams su myong; nyams 'experience' + -su + myong 'taste, undergo')
ཞིང: and, while (the form of zhing after ng; links one verb to the next; also shing, cing)
ཐོན་པའི: of emerging, of getting out (thon 'get out, emerge' + -pa'i 'of'): a clause placed before its noun
བཀག་པའི: of blocking, that blocks (bkag, past stem of 'gog 'to block', + -pa'i 'of'): a clause placed before its noun
རྩེ་གཅིག་ཏུ: one-pointedly, with a single mind (rtse 'point, tip' + gcig 'one' + -tu)
མཉམ་ཉིད: sameness, equality (mnyam 'equal' + nyid 'itself'): mnyam nyid ye shes 'the wisdom of sameness', shortened from mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes
ཡི: of (the form used after a vowel, yi; also gi, kyi, gyi, -'i) · perhaps 'by', standing for yis, where the verse needs it
ལ་སོགས་པ: and the like, and so on (la sogs pa)
ཉམས་པ: broken, impaired, spoiled (nyams pa): dam tshig nyams pa 'a broken commitment'
ལ་སོགས་པའི: of those and the like, and so on (la sogs pa + -'i 'of')
སྐལ་ཆད: cut off from fortune, luckless (skal 'fortune, lot' + chad 'cut off')
འདོད་ཆགས: desire, passion ('dod 'want' + chags 'attachment'): the mind's poison of the fourth day
བསྐྱོད: stirred, set in motion (bskyod, past of skyod)
བྲོས་བས: because they flee (bros 'flee' + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'because'): runs on to what follows
བཞི་པ: fourth (bzhi 'four' + -pa): zhag bzhi pa 'the fourth day'
ཡི་དྭགས: hungry ghost (yi dwags; Sanskrit preta), a being tormented by hunger and thirst
བོད: will call, to call (bod, the future stem of 'bod 'to call')
བདེ་བ་ཅན: the Blissful, Sukhāvatī, the buddha-field of the west (bde ba 'bliss' + can 'having')
གོས་དཀར་མོ: the White-Robed One, Pāṇḍaravāsinī (gos 'clothing' + dkar mo 'white', with the feminine -mo): the consort of the west
སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས: Avalokiteśvara, 'the one who looks with the eyes' (spyan 'eye', respectful, + ras gzigs 'looking'): the bodhisattva of compassion
འཇམ་དཔལ: Mañjuśrī, 'Gentle Glory' ('jam 'gentle' + dpal 'glory'): the bodhisattva of wisdom
གྷཱིརྟི་མ: perhaps Gītā, 'she of song' (ghīrti ma, the print's spelling, perhaps for gīti 'song'): a female bodhisattva, a Sanskrit name in Tibetan letters
ཨཱ་ལོ་ཀེ: Ālokā, 'she of light' (ā lo ke, Sanskrit āloke, the address of āloka 'light'): a female bodhisattva, a Sanskrit name in Tibetan letters
སོ་སོར: one by one, each by itself (so so 'each' + -r): so sor rtogs pa 'discerning each thing by itself'
རྟོགས་བའི: of understanding, of discerning (rtogs 'understand' + -ba'i, the print's spelling of -pa'i 'of')
ཆགས་ཞེན: attachment and clinging (chags 'be attached' + zhen 'cling'), the two verbs made one word
དྲག་པོའི: of the fierce, of the strong (drag po 'fierce' + -'i 'of')
ངང་དུ: in the state, in the condition (ngang 'state, nature' + -du 'in')
བྲོས་ཅིག: flee! (bros 'flee' + cig, which marks a command); ma bros cig 'do not flee'
ཆགས་པར: in being attached, attached (chags pa + -r): chags par byed 'be attached'
གླགས: opportunity, chance (glags): bzod glags med pa 'with no chance to bear it', unbearable
མྱོང: to experience, to suffer, to undergo (myong)
ཐར་ལམ: path to liberation (thar 'liberation' + lam 'path'), shortened from thar pa'i lam
སོར་རྟོགས: the discerning (wisdom) (sor rtogs, shortened from so sor rtogs pa 'discerning each thing by itself')
བསྐྱོལ: bring! (bskyol, read as skyol, the imperative of skyel 'bring', written with a prefixed b-)
སྲིད་དོ: can be, is possible (srid 'be possible' + the sentence-ending -do): mi srid 'it cannot be, it is impossible'
ཡུན་རིང་པའི: of long duration, long-lasting (yun 'duration' + ring pa 'long' + -'i 'of')
སྟབས: occasion, manner, circumstance (stabs): stabs kyis 'because of, by reason of'
སྤོང་བར: giving up (spong 'give up' + -bar): mi spong bar 'without giving up'
ཕྲག་དོག: jealousy, envy (phrag dog): the mind's poison of the fifth day
དངངས་སྐྲག: dread and terror (dngangs, the print's spelling of sngangs 'dread', + skrag 'be frightened')
མར: down, downward (mar, the opposite of yar 'up'); of time, 'on, onward'
དོན་ཡོད་གྲུབ་པའི: of Amoghasiddhi (don yod 'not in vain' + grub pa 'accomplished' + -'i 'of')
བྱོན་ནོ: comes (byon, the respectful 'come' used of a buddha, with one form for every tense, + the sentence-ending -no)
ཉོན་མོངས་པ: affliction, disturbing emotion (nyon mongs pa; Sanskrit kleśa), the name for the poisons of the mind
ལྷ་མ་ཡིན: demigod, asura (lha ma yin 'not-god'): a being who wars with the gods out of envy
ལྔ་པ: fifth (lnga 'five' + -pa): zhag lnga pa 'the fifth day'
རབ་བརྩེགས་པའི: of Heaped Up, of the piled high (rab 'very' + brtsegs 'stacked' + -pa'i 'of'): the name of a buddha-field of the north
དོན་ཡོད་གྲུབ་པ: Amoghasiddhi, 'He Whose Aim Is Accomplished' (don yod 'not in vain' + grub pa 'accomplished'): the buddha of the north and of the fifth day
གཙོ་འཁོར: chief and retinue (gtso 'chief' + 'khor 'retinue'): the buddha with those around him
རྡོ་རྗེ་རྒྱ་གྲམ: crossed vajra (rdo rje 'vajra' + rgya gram 'cross'): two vajras laid across each other, the emblem of the north
ནམ་མཁའ་ལྡིང: the garuḍa, the great bird (nam mkha' lding 'soaring in the sky')
ཤང་ཤང: shang-shang, a winged creature of the garuḍa kind, in pictures part bird and part human
དམ་ཚིག་སྒྲོལ་མ: Samayatārā, 'Tārā of the Commitment' (dam tshig 'sacred commitment' + sgrol ma 'she who frees'): the consort of the north

__broaden__.གྲུབ་པའི: of the established (grub pa 'established' + -'i 'of') · formed from, made of (… las grub pa'i 'formed from …')
__broaden__.ཟིན་པར: seizing, holding (zin + -par): zin par the tshom med 'no doubt that (they) will seize it' · caught, held (zin pa + -r): mi zin par 'without being caught'
__broaden__.གནས་སུ: in its place, in the place (gnas 'place' + -su 'in') · into the place of (mi'i gnas su ltung 'fall into the abode of humans')
